{{Quote|Chief of State Cal Omas today authorized new emergency measures to crack down on continuing unrest in Galactic City. Corel-Man passport holders now have forty-eight hours to report to their local CSF precinct and opt for repatriation or face internment. The move has been condemned by Senate representatives from Altyr Five, Obreedan, and Katraasii.|HNE lunchtime news bulletin|<ref name="Bloodlines" />}}
The '''Altyr system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Morshdine sector/Legends|Morshdine sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]],<ref name="Atlas" /> overlapping the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Region" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the sector saw [[Battle of Altyr V|conflict]] when [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone commander]] [[Deevis]] routed [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Altyr V]]. In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">According to the opening crawl, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' takes place five [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''Jedi Knight'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Therefore, ''Mysteries of the Sith'' takes place in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] maintained a [[Altyr V base|base]] on Altyr V and [[Battle of Altyr V (Galactic Civil War)|repelled]] a [[Dark Empire]] invasion force before evacuating the system.<ref name="MOS">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''</ref> By [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], Altyr V left the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] with [[Katraasii]] and other worlds to join the [[Confederation]].<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Altyr system first appeared in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''.<ref name="MOS" /> The region was later charted on a map at  of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] in the ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="Atlas" />
